title: PVBRF-ID: Private, Verifiable and Byzantine-Robust Federated Intrusion Detection for Oilfield Enterprise Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.12704v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning allows dispersed oilfield sites to train a shared intrusion detector without pooling network traffic, yet its aggregation step forces a choice between privacy and robustness. Byzantine-robust rules must read each update in the clear, whereas secure aggregation hides updates from the checks that detect poisoning. We present PVBRF-ID, a two-server protocol in which sites secret-share their updates and the servers jointly test each update's norm and its cosine similarity to a reference computed on a small clean root set, revealing one accept bit per site. Commitments, Merkle roots and a homomorphic audit make the inclusion of accepted updates publicly verifiable. On a 15-class Edge-IIoTset task with ten sites holding differently distributed data and ten random seeds, PVBRF-ID matched FedAvg on clean data (macro-F1 0.708 vs. 0.706) and withstood sign-flip attacks (0.696 vs. 0.091). translated_title: PVBRF-ID：面向油田企业网络的隐私保护、可验证且抗拜占庭攻击的联邦入侵检测
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使分散的油田站点无需汇集网络流量即可共同训练共享的入侵检测器，但其聚合步骤迫使我们只能在隐私与鲁棒性之间二选一。抗拜占庭攻击的规则必须以明文读取每个更新，而安全聚合则将更新隐藏起来，使其无法接受检测投毒的检查。我们提出了PVBRF-ID，这是一种双服务器协议：各站点对其更新进行秘密共享，两台服务器联合检验每个更新的范数及其与在一个小的干净根集上计算所得参考值之间的余弦相似度，且每个站点仅泄露一个接受比特。通过承诺机制、Merkle根和同态审计，被接受更新的纳入过程具备公开可验证性。在一个包含15个类别的Edge-IIoTset任务上，十个站点持有不同分布的数据并使用十个随机种子进行实验，PVBRF-ID在干净数据上与FedAvg表现相当（macro-F1为0.708对0.706），并能抵御符号翻转攻击（0.696对0.091）。面对控制……的自适应攻击者……
tldr: PVBRF-ID提出了一种双服务器联邦学习协议，通过站点对更新进行秘密共享、服务器联合检验范数与余弦相似度并结合承诺、Merkle根和同态审计，在不暴露更新的前提下同时实现隐私保护、公开可验证性与抗拜占庭鲁棒性，在油田入侵检测任务中达到与FedAvg相当的精度并能抵御投毒攻击。
en_tdlr: PVBRF-ID is a two-server federated learning protocol that simultaneously achieves privacy, public verifiability, and Byzantine robustness by secret-sharing updates and jointly testing each update's norm and cosine similarity, matched with commitments, Merkle roots, and homomorphic audit, matching FedAvg accuracy on clean data while withstanding poisoning attacks for oilfield intrusion detection.
